name: Kimberly-Clark
description: Kimberly-Clark makes disposable personal-care and paper products under Huggies, Kleenex, Scott, Kotex, Cottonelle, Poise, Depend and others, sold in more than 175 countries mostly through retailers (Walmart is about 16 percent of net sales). Revenue comes from repeat purchases of diapers, adult incontinence, feminine care, bath and facial tissue and professional wipes, priced against pulp and oil-based material costs. In 2025 it separated its International Family Care and Professional business into a joint venture, 51 percent sold to Suzano for about $1.7B on 2026-07-01 with 49 percent retained, leaving two reported segments, North America and International Personal Care. On 2025-11-02 it agreed to acquire Kenvue for stock and cash (about 280 million new shares and $6.7B cash), expected to close in the second half of 2026.
